description: Least-privilege deny rules for the capstone pipeline. Enforced at the IDE/runtime level alongside the Python hooks in .github/hooks/.

deny.reason: Secrets must never be read into model context. Use ${VAR} references only.
Agents must never create or modify this file; only a human reviewer may.
Each agent writes only inside its own workspace/artifacts/<agent>/ folder (see pre_write_isolation.py).
Only the orchestrator writes to state/run.json, summary.md, memory.json.
